description: EDS prolongation: non-involutive systems have strictly growing integral element space. cvc5 proves stasis contradicts non-involutivity.

test_non_involutive_no_growth.description: Violation: non-involutive system with no prolongation growth contradicts theorem

test_zero_dim_non_involutive.description: Zero-dimensional non-involutive: dim(I)=0 cannot grow under prolongation

test_prolongation_shrinks_integral_eleme.description: Impossibility: prolongation reduces integral element space
